notes.title: Laser Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Seems like the last patch caused a bug with how lasers worked, making it possible for them to kill you on the turn that you land on the goal ring.

This caused some levels, particularly in worlds 3 and 7, to become unsolvable.

That's been taken care of! Sorry for any inconvenience, please continue to enjoy Limiter!

notes.title: Fullscreen!
notes.notes:
Fullscreen mode is fully implemented! Let me know if there are issues with your specific monitor/settings and I'll try and fix them up.

I also fixed achievements which were still broken even when I thought they weren't!

notes.title: Gamepad Support FIXED / Achievements Re-Enabled
notes.notes:
Hi pre-release players, testers, streamers, press, etc.
Just wanted to let you know I've discovered and fixed an issue with gamepad support where the gamepad bindings option in the menu wasn't being loaded correctly for some players and you were stuck with the default controls. This has been fixed now!

I also at some stage in debugging for the demo release must have turned off stats/achievements. I've reenabled those, and I'm deeply sorry to all the streamers and reviewers that have, until now, missed out on those sweet sweet achievements. You can collect those now.

Thanks for playing Limiter!
